bill.title: Elections: voters; denying the right to vote on the basis of sex; prohibit.

posted_text:
⚖️ MI HB 6318 — Michigan Protects Voting Rights: No More Sex-Based Denials

Michigan is taking a stand against discrimination in voting.

This bill ensures that citizens of this state can vote regardless of their sex.

It clarifies that the state cannot deny or limit someone's right to vote simply because of their gender.

Sept. 1, 2026: Bill electronically reproduced 08/27/2026.
